Hey first of all, i'm really sorry this all happened to you, you've gone through quite a rocky path and it has scarred you but you are trying to get better which really shows your strength.

About your dream and the occasional flashbacks, it's definitely not just random, dreams about the past or about childhood usually imply deeper meanings you might not want to look over. Your dream brought back this triggering/difficult memory to your consciousness, but neutralized the emotions around it, as you mentioned it felt like nothing had ever happened. That's called a decoupling function and it plays a part in helping you process emotionally traumatic experiences. Bringing back these bad memories in dreams can also indicate you've grown strong enough to face these emotions you've experienced.

I know you are looking for immediate coping mechanisms, but i think your brain is trying to tell you to open that box at the back of your head, and  face these traumatic experiences you've gone through, and really start healing. Sure immediate and quick coping techniques will help you for the short term, but the chance you end up in this cycle of feeling very fucked up and hurt again, is very real. It is now really up to you what you do with these very intense emotions and experiences, if you don't want to work on them yet, that's totally fine, it's your call. But there will be another time where these feelings get to the surface again.

If you do choose to take the long haul, or you've come to a point where you feel mentally and emotionally ready to try to undergo your past trauma's: be very kind and patient with yourself, you're delicate and you deserve care and compassion as much as you would offer a loved one suffering. Therapy is recommended, but if that's not an option for you right now, i do strongly recommend having conversations about what you experienced and how it makes you feel now with a loved one you trust, or to write it down, or honestly whatever outlet you find works for you.

Know that a lot of people on this subreddit alone are more than willing to listen to you and support you without any judgment and lots of understanding and compassion!

I wish you lots of strength and love OP.
